# Loop step: re-probe unavailable drivers and restore them
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #139, sha256:17ca03ce82db4d754d9ab4340e2dda958fc2897a8e1afc0b592789be556d26d9). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (thin slice; code in mob-defaults, tracked on this board like the other loop cards)
- **Milestone:** Loop tooling: the mob keeps itself running
- **Source:** Product direction, 2026-10-28 (the mob loop always re-tests whether unavailable models are available again) and Decider D88. Found when Copilot's quota ran out mid-run (reset 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC) and its holdout rows were marked unavailable.
- **Depends on:** 064
- **Story:** As the product owner, I want the loop to re-probe every unavailable driver at each card boundary and on a timer, and to restore its seats and rerun its unavailable rows when it is back, so that nobody has to remember that a driver is out.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a driver marked unavailable in DRIVERS.md, When a card boundary is reached or the timer (30 to 60 minutes, or the known reset time if sooner) fires, Then the loop runs that driver's probe with a short timeout, writes status, last probe time, any reset time found in the error text or the account endpoint, and any probe failure with its error text to DRIVERS.md, and never blocks the loop (a test with a fake probe that hangs)
  2. Given a probe that reports the driver is back, When the loop handles it, Then the driver's author and voter seats are restored in the rotation, the rows marked unavailable for it are listed for rerun with their labels, an event is appended to DRIVERS.md, and a second probe does not repeat the restore (tests with fake probes)
  3. Given the probes, When they are written, Then Copilot is probed through the account quota endpoint (reads quota, spends none) and other drivers through a one-line prompt on the harness launch path, each with a recorded fixture test, and the default working-agreement template and DRIVERS.default.md in mob-defaults carry the rule

## Context

- Standing rule text already added to TEAM_WORKING_AGREEMENT.md and the mob-defaults template (Driver availability). Ranked with the other loop cards below the Usable v1 path (Decider D88 round 3); until it lands the rule is met by DRIVERS.md and a tracked 30 minute re-probe run by the facilitator. Probes need bounded timeouts, failure logging and fake-probe tests (Decider D88, Codex).
